caption: The drawing depicts a metal trivet with a circular, gear-like outer rim and a six-petaled, symmetrical floral pattern in the center. The floral pattern features textured leaves radiating from a central hub, evenly spaced within the ring. The trivet has three short, straight legs attached to its underside, providing support and elevation. There is a double-looped handle extending from one side of the rim, which is depicted with a curved and twisted form. The image includes three perspectives: a large, detailed isometric view in the lower right, a smaller overhead view in the upper left, and a side profile view in the upper left below the overhead view, which shows the legs extending downward. Below the side view, there is a small linear scale for measurement. The drawing is rendered in shades of gray, using pencil on an off-white, slightly aged paper background.
title: Flat Iron Holder
